description: Recent earthquakes worldwide or around a place via USGS. Returns recent earthquakes with magnitude, place, time, depth and coordinates. Optionally search around a place within a radius. Use for seismic activity checks. Price $0.010 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).

days.description: How many days back to search

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of place)

place.description: City or address, e.g. Berlin or 1600 Pennsylvania Ave. Not needed when lat and lon are given

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around the place

name: world_earthquakes
title: Recent earthquakes worldwide or around a place via USGS
